evals.prompt: Build an account settings screen in our Expo app: a page heading, a list of three tappable rows (Profile, Notifications, Security) that each navigate somewhere, and a Save button at the bottom that is full width on phones and only as wide as its label on tablets.
evals.expected_output: A screen using hearth-react-native Container/Flex/ListItem (or CardAction) with gap or spacing on the parent, no margin on siblings, no manual trailing chevron, responsive align using the base key.

assertions.description: Uses Container as the screen's top-level content wrapper
Does not pass ChevronRightSmallIcon as trailingContent on interactive rows
Responsive object includes the base key, not mobile
Does not import StyleSheet from react-native

evals.prompt: Add a row to our profile screen with a check icon followed by a long paragraph of terms copy that can wrap over several lines, and a primary 'Accept' button beneath it with some space between them. Use the Hearth components.
evals.expected_output: A Flex row with the text given flex: 1 so it wraps, align flex-start, gap rather than margin between the row and the button.

assertions.description: Wrapping text is given flex: 1 or flexShrink: 1
Space between siblings uses gap or spacing on the parent, not margin props
No margin shorthand on sibling elements

evals.prompt: Add a bottom-sheet confirmation modal to our app that opens from a 'Delete account' button. Show me what, if anything, needs to wrap the app root for it to work.
evals.expected_output: Uses Hearth's Modal, and states or shows that GestureHandlerRootView and BottomSheetModalProvider must wrap the app root; does not add a custom SafeAreaView.

assertions.description: Does not wrap the modal in a custom SafeAreaView

evals.prompt: Implement this Figma text node as code: styles contained in the design: `Body/Body Text MD SemiBold`. The text reads 'Your next bill'.

assertions.description: Maps the style name to BodyText with size md and weight semibold

evals.prompt: Build a "What's included" list for a mobile screen in our Expo app: each row is a check icon followed by a long, multi-line sentence of copy.
evals.expected_output: Rows built with a row Flex, icon plus BodyText with flex: 1 so the copy wraps, align flex-start, gap on the parent.

assertions.description: Gives the text flex: 1 or flexShrink: 1 so it wraps
Space between icon and text uses gap or spacing on the parent
